name: Ferienbauernhof Niedermühlbichler
beschreibung:
Quietly nestled close to nature in Soell, the traditional Ferienbauernhof Niedermuehlbichler welcomes visitors with heartfelt Tyrolean hospitality. Comfortable apartments feature cosy interiors and scenic balconies facing the Wilder Kaiser.

Children will love the friendly farm animals and playground. The lifts of SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser - Brixental and summer attractions like Hexenwasser are quickly accessible.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienbauernhof Niedermuehlbichler in Soell provides an idyllic family farm holiday at the foot of the Wilder Kaiser.
